raw_record.question_text:
Read a contour topographic map of a certain region.

<image1>

The river section between A and C of this river has ice-flood phenomena every spring. In alphabetical order, write the name of the first riverbank where the river's sediment deposition effect is relatively significant: ____.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: note that A is north/east of C on the mapped river reach, and labeled banks D, E, F, B lie along successive bends. From the text, use “AC之间每年春季出现凌汛” plus the latitude marks to infer the river flows generally from south to north, i.e. from C toward A. Then trace the river from C to A on the image. At the first meander after C, identify the convex/inner bank; the label on that depositional bank is D. Therefore the first bank in alphabetical/order along the river with significant deposition is D岸.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：这是一幅等高线地形图，图中有经纬线标注，右侧可见50°纬线，顶部有68°经线标注。河流用较粗的黑色弯曲线表示，AC河段从左下方的C附近曲折延伸到中部偏右的A附近；A位于C的偏北、偏东方向。沿河弯道附近标有多个河岸字母，包括C附近弯道内侧的D，继续向上游/下游弯道附近的E、F，以及A附近的B。
推理：题干说明AC之间河段每年春季出现凌汛。春季凌汛通常发生在河流由较低纬度流向较高纬度的河段，即河流大致自南向北流。结合图中A在C的偏北方向，可判断该河AC段流向大致为从C流向A。沿河流从C向A追踪，遇到的第一处明显弯道处，泥沙堆积较显著的位置应在弯曲河道的凸岸、内侧岸，因为该处流速较慢、易沉积。图中C之后第一处弯道的内侧凸岸标注为D，因此第一处泥沙堆积作用比较显著的河岸是D岸。
